prompt.content:
You are analyzing the evaluation of one candidate objective function for a GNN-based netlist tier-partitioner (2-tier 3D IC).
Hypothesis of the change: The critical-pair locality term at coefficient 1.0 (c065, +0.141, best robust) is slightly over-pulling on C1 (repair_flips 103→119, cut 137→148); scaling it down modestly to 0.7 keeps the C1 crit_cross benefit while giving C2/C3 more room, improving robustness across circuits.
Rule-based digest (scores are improvement ratios vs. the official baseline; C1..C3 are the training circuits by size):
total=+0.117 robust(mean-std)=+0.014 min_case=+0.015 seed_std=0.030 tns_mean=+0.030 all_valid=True
  C1: score=+0.074 dWNS=+10.0% dTNS=+6.3% per-seed=[+0.06 +0.03 +0.13]
  C2: score=+0.029 dWNS=+3.7% dTNS=+2.8% per-seed=[+0.08 -0.00 +0.01]
  C3: score=+0.015 dWNS=+3.4% dTNS=+0.5% per-seed=[+0.02 +0.02 +0.00]
  partition stats vs baseline:
  C1: cut 137->148, wcut 421->438, crit_cross 0.011->0.016, repair_flips 103->118, changed-vs-baseline 17.3%
  C2: cut 318->309, wcut 1007->964, crit_cross 0.000->0.000, repair_flips 238->233, changed-vs-baseline 6.0%
  C3: cut 582->587, wcut 1955->1977, crit_cross 0.069->0.074, repair_flips 353->345, changed-vs-baseline 3.4%
Write <=120 words. If some runs are INVALID, first classify the failure (crash / non-finite loss / balance repair failure / timeout) and whether it is systematic or sporadic - an invalid candidate says nothing about the hypothesis itself; suggest how to make the same idea legal. Otherwise: (1) did the hypothesis hold? (2) which circuit/metric moved and the plausible mechanism (cut nets, critical-pair cross-tier, repair flips)? (3) is the seed spread acceptable? (4) one concrete next step. No preamble.

response:
(1) Partially. Scaling to 0.7 still over-pulls C1: crit_cross rose 0.011→0.016, cut 137→148, repair_flips 103→118 — worse than the 1.0 hypothesis predicted, so the "keeps C1 benefit" claim fails; C1 score +0.074 is decent but driven by WNS not locality.

(2) C2 improved (cut 318→309, wcut 1007→964, flips 238→233) — more room helped. C3 roughly flat (cut 582→587, crit_cross 0.069→0.074). Mechanism: reduced coefficient still permits critical-pair splitting on C1's tighter timing.

(3) Seed spread: C1 [+0.06,+0.03,+0.13] is wide; seed_std 0.030 borderline.

(4) Try coefficient 0.4–0.5 and add a crit_cross penalty cap on C1.
